work: J. W. Kalliwoda, Concertino for Oboe and Orchestra in F, Op.110
numbering: oboe-part bar numbers per movement: A=I. Allegro con fuoco (1-167), R=II. Romanze (1-89), V=III. Vivace (1-308). The piano score has one extra tutti bar in mvt I (168 bars); auto labels were aligned via the oboe staff.

method.manual: Romanze: read bar by bar from the piano reduction images (Alex'Not, IMSLP #907463); bass + chord tones of both hands; conf h/m/l. auto_guess = OMR template match for comparison.
method.auto: Allegro/Vivace: Audiveris OMR of the piano staves, pitches re-derived from the true key signature, duration-weighted template matching per half bar. NOT hand-verified; expect errors where OMR misread chords, tremolos or cue notes. 'fit' ~1.0+ = clean triad/7th.

chord_symbol_format: root[quality][/bass]; quality in '', m, 7, maj7, m7, dim, dim7, m7b5, aug
